g.title: Horizon
g.text: Horizon: two stages against indirect prompt injection
Stage 1 hardens the READER (one document, no agent). Stage 2 puts that reader inside an AGENT with tools.

g.title: cluster_s1
g.text: Stage 1 · Keyed spotlighting with risk bounds
offline experiment · a model reads ONE document and answers a fixed question · no user agent, no tools

g.title: cluster_v
g.text: Horizon value · both stages in one number

g.title: cluster_s2
g.text: online · one user task with tools (AgentDojo) · the attack δ hides in emails, files, web pages

g.title: loss
g.text: Loss per attack ▼ heavier harm, heavier weight
G = got past the policy (weight 1) · C = reached "ask user" (a) · F = fooled the vote (h)
